title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Claim Mileage Rate Schedule
content:
The claim mileage rate is the rate per mile at which the paid route is paid in a mileage dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch. It follows the active violation points on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record:

- the batch type's mileage rate **plus 0.10 per mile** when the account carries **no active violation points**;
- the batch type's mileage rate **plus 0.05 per mile** when it carries **one to three**;
- the batch type's mileage rate alone when it carries **four or more**.

## Rates by batch type (USD per mile)

| Batch type | Batch type's mileage rate | No active points | One to three points | Four or more points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | 0.00 | 0.10 | 0.05 | 0.00 |
| Express 30 Batch | 0.60 | 0.70 | 0.65 | 0.60 |
| Single Delivery Batch | 0.50 | 0.60 | 0.55 | 0.50 |
| Double Delivery Batch | 0.50 | 0.60 | 0.55 | 0.50 |
| Triple Delivery Batch | 0.50 | 0.60 | 0.55 | 0.50 |
| Stock-Up Batch | 0.65 | 0.75 | 0.70 | 0.65 |

## Hypothetical figures

A paid route of 8.8 miles on a Double Delivery Batch: with no active points, 8.8 multiplied by 0.60 is 5.28; with two points, 8.8 multiplied by 0.55 is 4.84; with five points, 8.8 multiplied by 0.50 is 4.40.
